content: Sa7oolenne Moytille Xeygiza Maccassayo
He wode Filisxeeme asay Isra7eele asaa olanaas ba olanchchata shiishshides. Ankuseykka Dawite, «Neninne ne asay tanara issife olas kezanayssa erite» gides.
Dawitikka, «Tani ne oosanchchay ay ooththanaakko neni ne hu7era be7andasa» gides. Ankuseykka, «Ero lo7okko! Ta diza layth ubbaan ta nena taas bonchcho zabe histtana» gides.
He wode Sameeli hayqqi gam7ides; Isra7eele asay ubbay iza katamaan Eraaman yeekkidi moogides; Sa7ooli marotanne moytille haasayssizayta kase dereppe gooddides.
Filisxeeme asay issi bolla shiiqetti yiidi Sunemen uttiin Sa7ooli qasse Isra7eele asaa ubbaa shiishshidi Gilbo7a zumaa bolla uttides.
Sa7ooli Filisxeeme ola asaa be7idi babbides; iza wozinay keehippe hirgides.
Izi GODAA oychchiin GODAY izas agumon gidiin woykko Urimen woykko nabeta baggara zaaro immibeenna.
Sa7oolikka ba oosanchchata, «Ane hayqqida as denththiza maccas taas koyite; tani baada izo oychchana» gides. Isttika izas, «Hekko hayqqida as denththiza maccassaya En-Dooren dawus» gida.

Hessa gishshas Sa7ooli ba may7o laammi hara may7o may7idi, ba medhakka laammidi nam7u asatara issife omars maccassayko bides; izikka izo, «Taas moytilleta oychcharkkii; ta nees yootizaade denththarkkii» gides.

Maccassaya gidikko, «Hekko Sa7ooli marotanne moytille denththi haasayssizayta biittafe izi wostti dhayssidaakko izi istta bolla ooththidayssa ne eraasa; histtiin ne tana wodhisanaassinne ta shemppos woximade woththanaas ays koyay?» gadus.
Sa7oolikka izis, «De7o GODAY be7iin hayssi ha yo7ozi ne bolla qixaate ehenna» gi caaqqides.
Maccassayakka, «Nees oona denththoo?» gaada oychchadus. Izikka, «Taas Sameela denththa» gides.
Maccassayakka Sameela be7ida mala ba qaala dhoqqu histta waassadus; Sa7ooles, «Ne Sa7oole gida uttada tana aazas baleththadii?» gadus.
Kawozikka, «Babbofa; ha7i nees aazee beettizay?» gides. Izakka, «Issi ayanay biittafe pude kezishin be7adis» gadus.

Izikka, «Izas medhay ay misatizee?» gi oychchides. Izakka, «Kaabba may7ida issi cima bitaney pude kessa bolla dees» gadus. Sa7oolikka maccassaya be7idayssi Sameela gididayssa erides; biitta bolla gufannidi izis kushe denththides.

Sameelikka Sa7ooles, «Tana duufoppe denththada ays shempo diggay?» gides. Sa7ooli, «Tani keeha ceecadis; Filisxeemeti tana olishe deettes; Xoossi taappe haakkides; nabeta baggara gidiin woykko agumon taas zaaribeenna. Hessa gishshas ta ay ooththana bessizaakko ne taas yootana mala nena xeygadis» gides.
Sameeli izas, «Histtiin GODAY neeppe haakkiko, nees izi morkke gidikko ne tana ays oychchay?
GODAY ta baggara nees yootidayssa polides; GODAY ne kawoteththaa ne kusheppe woththi ekkidi ne shooro Dawites immides.
Neni GODAAS azazettontta aggida gishshassinne suulliza iza hanqoza ne Amaaleeqeta bolla polontta aggida gishshas GODAY hach hayssa ne bolla ooththides.
GODAY nenanne Isra7eeleta Filisxeemetas aaththi immana; neninne ne nayti wonto tanara gidandeta; qasseka GODAY Isra7eele olanchchata Filisxeemetas aaththi immana» gi zaarides.
Sameeli yootida qaalaappe dendidayssan Sa7ooli babon kumidi heerakka biitta bolla porccu gi kundides. Kumeththa gallassinne omars kath montta gishshas izas wolqqay ixxides.
Maccassaya Sa7oolekko yadus; izi keehi dagammidayssa beyada izas, «Hekko, tani ne oosanchchaya ne qaalaa siyadis; ta shemppo bayzada ne taas yootidayssa poladis.
Ha7i tani ne ashkaraya yootizayssa siyarkkii! Ne minettada baana mala hanno ta nees shiishshiza guuththa kaththiyo ma» gadus.
Sa7ooli, «Miikke» giidi ixxides. Gido attiin izara diza asati maccassayra gididi minththi woossiin istta qaala siyides; biitta bollafe dendidi hiixa bolla uttides.
Maccassaya bason ohala mari dizayssa elela ekkada shukkadus; guuththa dhiille ekka munuqadus; irshoy gelontta uketh uukkadus.
Histtada Sa7oolessinne izara diza asata sinth aaththadus; isttika midaappe guye he gallassa omars dendi bida.
